text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion and the Trainer had come to 
watch the Arima Kinen. Air Shakur would be 
running in the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The result—Air Shakur suffered defeat. She 
remarked that, while struggling against 
the predetermined outcome dictated by 
data, she had seen hope in Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wanted this race to alter the outcome. 
Yet Fine Motion's heart remained 
unchanged. Everything reached its 
conclusion, precisely as predicted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, by running the whole way through, 
Air Shakur felt content with her chosen 
path. Fine Motion, too, had her own path 
to walk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Fine Motion held a press 
conference to announce her return to her 
home country. Tears glittered in her 
eyes...
